true_positives.matched_candidate:
Spawned flushers never pass the new kill guard

Workers are created with multiprocessing.get_context("spawn").Process, which produces SpawnProcess instances. These are not instances of multiprocessing.Process (the default-context Process class), so this guard is false for production workers.
